# A proposal stops short of 10KB of messages, though it always offers one:
# two of 6000 bytes go one at a time.
@queued P Q9TEST Q2BBS Q1TEST 1_Q1BBS 6000
@queued P Q9TEST Q2BBS Q1TEST 2_Q1BBS 6000
@answering
> FF
< FB P Q9TEST Q2BBS Q1TEST 1_Q1BBS 6001
< F> C5
> FS -
> FF
< FB P Q9TEST Q2BBS Q1TEST 2_Q1BBS 6001
< F> C4
> FS -
> FF
< FQ
< *** disconnected
@check accepted=0 forwarded=0 refused=2 pending=0
